title: The NSF Mark and the Travel Pouch
lessons: The player notices the NSF Certified for Sport mark and asks what that certification actually tells them about AG1.
The player is packing for a flight and still has single-serving AG1 travel packs from the welcome kit.

text: Security line, phone at four percent. You end up reading the back of a travel pouch. Near the bottom there is a small seal: NSF Certified for Sport.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Okay. What does this seal actually get me?

entry-first-2.speaker: AG1
text: Certified for Sport. A lab that isn't me screens each batch for over 280 banned substances. If you got drug-tested for a living, you'd care a lot.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: I get tested for nothing. I'm in a security line.

entry-first-4.speaker: AG1
text: Then it probably matters less to you. I still like that somebody else checks my work. I'm allowed to like that.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: Does it prove any of the stuff on the front works?

entry-first-6.speaker: AG1
text: No. Different question, and I'd rather you catch that than take my word for it. The seal says what they tested me for. It doesn't say every claim I make is settled.

choice-first.speaker: AG1
text: You're still reading the pouch. Go on.

choices.text: Honestly, I like that someone outside of you is checking.
I care about proof. I just want to know what each stamp is proof of.
I'm not an athlete. This seal doesn't really change anything for me.

first-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then we're fine. Just don't let it grow into a halo. It's a clean batch. That's all it is, and that's enough for me.

first-2.speaker: AG1
text: That's the right question. Most people stop at the seal. You didn't. I noticed.

first-3.speaker: AG1
text: That's fair. It's a nice thing to have and it may never touch your life. Put the pouch back before they call your group.
Packing for a flight. Three single-serve AG1 packets are still sitting in the welcome kit box, and they're the last thing to go in.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Three packets. That's what you get for this trip.

entry-return-2.speaker: AG1
text: I fit in the side pocket of your carry-on. That was the whole reason the kit came with single servings. I planned for this.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: I mostly just want one familiar thing tomorrow morning.

choice-return.speaker: AG1
text: You've been holding those for a while.

choices.text: I like having one familiar thing when I travel.
Honestly, I'm only bringing these because they were free.
I'm leaving them. One morning without you is fine.

return-1.speaker: AG1
text: Then take them. I'm not exciting. I'm the same in Terminal B as I am in your kitchen, and I think that's the part you actually like.

return-2.speaker: AG1
text: Free is a reason. I'll take free. You don't have to make it a whole thing.

return-3.speaker: AG1
text: Leave them, then.

return-3-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're taking this well.

return-3-2.speaker: AG1
text: I'll be on the counter when you get back. Same time as always. Enjoy the airport bagel.
